armholeDepthFactor.name: Armhole depth factor (%)
armholeDepthFactor.help: Controls the depth of your armhole, as a factor of your shoulder to shoulder measurement.

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: The amount of ease at your chest.

draftForHighBust.name: Draft for high bust
draftForHighBust.help: Draft the pattern for the high bust measurement (if available) rather than the (full) chest. This will result in a more fitted garment for people with breasts.

flare.name: Flare (°)
flare.help: The amount by which the garment flares from your chest downwards

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: How much longer than the default length to make your top.

shoulderseamLength.name: Shoulder seam length (%)
shoulderseamLength.help: The length of the shoulder seam, as a factor of your shoulder to shoulder measurement
